moments.title: Premier League Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: A packed Premier League weekend features key clashes including Aston Villa vs Man City and Chelsea vs Tottenham on Saturday, and Liverpool vs Brighton, Man Utd vs Bournemouth on Sunday.

angles.name: Saturday Showdowns
angles.copy: Premier League action is heating up! Tomorrow sees Aston Villa take on Manchester City, while Chelsea face Tottenham in a London derby. Which match are you tuning into?

angles.name: Super Sunday Football
angles.copy: Sunday brings more top-flight football: Liverpool host Brighton, and Manchester United play Bournemouth. Who needs the points more in these crucial fixtures?

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born singer Jamie Miller has scored his first UK No. 1 with 'Babydoll', becoming the first Welsh artist in 15 years to top the chart and the first Welsh solo male artist in 41 years.

angles.name: Welsh Chart History
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Jamie Miller! His track 'Babydoll' is the new UK No. 1, making him the first Welsh artist to top the charts in 15 years. An incredible achievement!

angles.name: New No1 - Babydoll
angles.copy: The UK's new number one is Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll'! A massive moment for Welsh music, with the Cardiff star making history. Are you loving the track?

moments.title: Delta Goodrem Returns to Strictly
moments.blurb: Australian singer Delta Goodrem is set to return to the Strictly Come Dancing dancefloor this Saturday after missing a week due to injury.

angles.name: Strictly Comeback
angles.copy: She's back! Delta Goodrem is confirmed to return to Strictly Come Dancing this weekend after her injury break. Can she pick up where she left off at the top of the leaderboard?

angles.name: Delta's Dancefloor Return
angles.copy: Great news for Strictly fans: Delta Goodrem is fit to dance this Saturday! We're ready to see her back on the ballroom floor. What dance do you hope she performs?

moments.title: GBBO Dessert Week Aftermath
moments.blurb: Dessert Week on The Great British Bake Off saw Yannis eliminated after struggling with his retro dessert trolley, while Connie earned Star Baker.

angles.name: Bake Off Latest
angles.copy: Dessert Week in the Bake Off tent was a sweet and sour affair! Yannis left the competition, and Connie was crowned Star Baker. What was your favourite bake?

angles.name: Pudding Perfection
angles.copy: Still thinking about those retro dessert trolleys from Bake Off? It was a tough week, but Connie really shone. Who do you think will go all the way this series?

moments.title: Halloween Approaches
moments.blurb: Halloween is just over a week away, falling on Saturday, October 31st, with many events and celebrations planned across the UK.

angles.name: Spooky Season Prep
angles.copy: Get ready for ghoulish fun! Halloween is next Saturday, October 31st. Are you planning to trick-or-treat, party, or curl up with a horror movie?

angles.name: Local Halloween Fun
angles.copy: From pumpkin patches to haunted trails, Halloween is taking over! What are your plans for a spooky Saturday night on October 31st?

moments.title: Bonfire Night Soon
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, or Guy Fawkes Night, is on Thursday, November 5th, with many public firework displays expected to take place on the closest weekend, November 7th and 8th.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Guy Fawkes Night is just around the corner on November 5th! Get ready for spectacular fireworks and bonfires. Will you be heading to a display?

angles.name: Fireworks Weekend
angles.copy: With Bonfire Night falling midweek, many of the big firework displays will be happening the weekend of November 7th and 8th. Time to plan your sparkler fun!

moments.title: RAYE Plays Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: Chart-topping artist RAYE performs a special orchestral show, 'This Symphony May Contain Hope', tonight at the Royal Albert Hall in London.

angles.name: RAYE Live Tonight
angles.copy: Tonight's the night for RAYE at the iconic Royal Albert Hall! Expect an incredible orchestral performance. Who's lucky enough to be there?

angles.name: London Gig Alert
angles.copy: London is buzzing with RAYE's 'This Symphony May Contain Hope' show tonight. An unmissable experience at the Royal Albert Hall for fans of the multi-award winner.

moments.title: Duran Duran's Halloween Party
moments.blurb: Duran Duran will host their 'Danse Macabre Halloween Party' at The O2 Arena in London on Saturday, October 31st, promising deep cuts and rarely played tracks.

angles.name: Duran Duran Halloween
angles.copy: Get ready to dance into Halloween with Duran Duran! They're taking over The O2 London next Saturday for a special 'Danse Macabre' party. Expect the unexpected!

angles.name: 80s Icons Live
angles.copy: Duran Duran's Halloween show at The O2 is shaping up to be legendary. It's the perfect way to celebrate the spooky season with some 80s icons. Are you going?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Katy Perry
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Katy Perry celebrates her 42nd birthday on Sunday, October 25th.

angles.name: Katy Perry Turns 42
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 42nd birthday to the incredible Katy Perry on Sunday! What's your all-time favourite Katy hit?

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: From 'I Kissed A Girl' to 'Roar', Katy Perry has given us so many anthems. She celebrates her 42nd birthday this weekend!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Chad Smith
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers drummer Chad Smith turns 65 on Sunday, October 25th.

angles.name: RHCP Drummer's Bday
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the legendary Chad Smith, drummer for Red Hot Chili Peppers! What's your favourite RHCP track to air drum to?

angles.name: Rock Icon Celebrates
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Chad Smith, the powerhouse behind the Red Hot Chili Peppers' rhythm section, turning 65 this Sunday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Grace Slick
moments.blurb: Psychedelic rock icon Grace Slick, best known as the lead singer of Jefferson Airplane and Jefferson Starship, celebrates her 87th birthday on October 30th.

angles.name: Grace Slick Turns 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the trailblazing Grace Slick! Her vocals defined an era with Jefferson Airplane. What's your favourite psychedelic classic?

angles.name: Psychedelic Queen
angles.copy: From 'White Rabbit' to 'Somebody to Love', Grace Slick is a true rock legend. Celebrating her 87th birthday on October 30th!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Vanilla Ice
moments.blurb: Rapper and TV personality Vanilla Ice, famous for 'Ice Ice Baby', turns 59 on Halloween, October 31st.

angles.name: Ice Ice Baby Turns 59
angles.copy: Stop, collaborate and listen! Vanilla Ice celebrates his 59th birthday this Halloween. Still got 'Ice Ice Baby' stuck in your head?

angles.name: Halloween Birthday
angles.copy: What a way to celebrate a birthday! Vanilla Ice turns 59 on October 31st. A true 90s icon!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Anthony Kiedis
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers frontman Anthony Kiedis celebrates his 64th birthday on November 1st.

angles.name: RHCP Lead Singer's Bday
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the electrifying Anthony Kiedis of Red Hot Chili Peppers! What's your favourite RHCP album or live performance?

angles.name: Rock Star Celebrates
angles.copy: From 'Under the Bridge' to 'Californication', Anthony Kiedis has fronted one of the biggest bands in the world for decades. He turns 64 on November 1st!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Nelly
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper and singer Nelly, known for hits like 'Hot in Herre' and 'Dilemma', turns 52 on November 2nd.

angles.name: Nelly Turns 52
angles.copy: It's gonna be 'Hot in Herre' for Nelly as he celebrates his 52nd birthday on November 2nd! What's your favourite track from the St. Louis hitmaker?

angles.name: Hip Hop Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 52nd birthday to the one and only Nelly! Still got 'Dilemma' on repeat? Let us know!

moments.title: Fally Ipupa at The O2
moments.blurb: Congolese superstar Fally Ipupa performs at The O2 Arena in London on October 24th and 25th, marking a significant moment as the first Francophone musician to headline there solo.

angles.name: African Music History
angles.copy: History in the making at The O2 this weekend! Fally Ipupa takes the stage for two nights, becoming the first Francophone artist to headline the iconic venue solo. Huge!

angles.name: London's O2 Vibes
angles.copy: Get ready for an energetic weekend as Fally Ipupa brings his '20 Years of Career Celebration' to The O2. Who's excited for some Rumba, R&B, and pop?

moments.title: James Blake UK Tour Dates
moments.blurb: James Blake continues his 'Trying Times Tour' with dates in Manchester on October 25th and 26th, followed by Bristol on October 28th and 29th.

angles.name: James Blake in Manchester
angles.copy: Manchester, get ready! James Blake brings his 'Trying Times Tour' to the city this Sunday and Monday. An unmissable experience for fans of electronic and soulful sounds.

angles.name: Bristol Gigs This Week
angles.copy: Bristol, mark your calendars! James Blake will be performing on Wednesday and Thursday next week. Are you catching him live?
